name: historical-final-check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && (status=0; bun research/egraph/historical/q3.ts || status=1; bun test research/egraph/*.test.ts || status=1; bunx tsc -p research/egraph/historical --pretty false || status=1; bunx tsc -p research/egraph --pretty false || status=1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config research/egraph || status=1; bunx --package @commitlint/cli@19.8.1 commitlint --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/egraph/historical/commit-message.txt || status=1; exit $status)
